title: Scalar localization of a permitted contravariant bilinear functor
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, D an A-linear preadditive category [def-weil-linear-category], p in A, q an object predicate on D^op×D, and B:q.FullSubcategory → D a functor. Suppose its Hom action is A-bilinear: for integral permitted pairs P,Q there is an A-linear-in-each-variable map beta_PQ from Hom(Q_1,P_1) and Hom(P_2,Q_2) to Hom(BP,BQ), equal on (a,b) to B(a^op,b). Let qprime be a predicate on L_p(D)^op×L_p(D), where L_p(D) is the raw scalar localization [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization], such that every qprime-pair has its underlying integral pair in q. Then there exists a unique functor F:qprime.FullSubcategory → L_p(D) with object map given by the localized value of B on that underlying pair and separately A[1/p]-linear Hom actions whose value at (c tensor a,d tensor b) is (cd) tensor B(a^op,b). No converse implication between q and qprime is assumed, and no constructibility or closure condition on qprime is required.

proof.text: Base change the integral bilinear Hom map and compose with the inverse distribution isomorphism for base change of tensor products. Curry to obtain the localized separately linear action. Its value on pure tensors multiplies the two coefficients. Four tensor inductions prove compatibility with composition from the integral functor laws and commutativity of coefficients; identities follow from the pure-tensor formula. This constructs the functor on the permitted full subcategory. Double tensor induction and functor extensionality prove uniqueness. The object restriction is used only to supply the underlying permitted integral pairs.

theorem restrictedHom_existsUnique :
    ∃! F : q'.FullSubcategory ⥤ ScalarLocalization A D p,
      (∀ P, F.obj P = ⟨B.obj (⟨(op P.obj.1.unop.obj, P.obj.2.obj), hq' P.obj P.property⟩)⟩) ∧
      (∀ P Q : q'.FullSubcategory,
        ∃ b : (Q.obj.1.unop ⟶ P.obj.1.unop) →ₗ[Localization.Away p]
          (P.obj.2 ⟶ Q.obj.2) →ₗ[Localization.Away p] (F.obj P ⟶ F.obj Q),
          (∀ a b', F.map (ObjectProperty.homMk (Prod.mkHom a.op b')) = b a b') ∧
          ∀ (a : Q.obj.1.unop.obj ⟶ P.obj.1.unop.obj) (b' : P.obj.2.obj ⟶ Q.obj.2.obj)
            (c d : Localization.Away p),
            HEq (b (c ⊗ₜ[A] a) (d ⊗ₜ[A] b'))
              ((c * d) ⊗ₜ[A] B.map (ObjectProperty.homMk
                (X := ⟨(op P.obj.1.unop.obj, P.obj.2.obj), hq' P.obj P.property⟩)
                (Y := ⟨(op Q.obj.1.unop.obj, Q.obj.2.obj), hq' Q.obj Q.property⟩)
                (Prod.mkHom a.op b'))))
